description: Draft Belfast Bicycle Network 2017 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. This data contains the Draft for the Belfast Bicycle Network from the Department for Infrastructure. The network is not final and is subject to change. A Consultation was set up to obtain views on the Draft Belfast Bicycle Network which can be accessed here: (Consultation Closes 13th April 2017). Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
